examples: I have zero cookies left.
Five take away five is zero.
The score was three to zero.

more.def: The number 0, which means no amount at all.
examples: Water freezes at zero degrees Celsius.
The temperature fell below zero.
There is zero chance of snow in July here.

easy.def: A line that goes one way and then the other, again and again.
examples: I drew a zigzag on my paper.
The rabbit ran in a zigzag.
My sweater has a zigzag on it.

more.def: A line or path with sharp turns from side to side.
examples: The path went up the hill in a zigzag.
Lightning made a bright zigzag across the sky.
She cut a zigzag along the edge of the paper.

easy.def: A thing with tiny teeth that opens and closes a coat or bag.
examples: My coat has a zipper.
Zip up your zipper. It is cold!
The zipper on my bag is broken.

more.def: A fastener with two rows of small teeth that lock together when you slide a tab.
examples: The zipper on my backpack got stuck.
The tent door closes with a long zipper.
He pulled the zipper of his coat up to his chin.

easy.def: A place set apart for one thing.
examples: Cars go slow in a school zone.
This is a no-running zone.
The ball went into the end zone.

more.def: An area that is set apart for a special use or that differs from the areas around it.
examples: There is a quiet zone in the library for reading.
The city made a car-free zone in the center.
Hard hats must be worn in the building zone.
The race car will zoom by.
The bee zooms by my ear.
A jet zoomed over us.

more.def: To move very quickly, often with a humming sound.
examples: The bikes zoomed down the hill.
The skaters zoomed around the rink.
A motorcycle zoomed past us on the highway.
